deviation: Streamable is an Iterable and stream Supplier. Supplier-backed sources obtain a fresh stream each time. Implementors provide stream() until the lazy Iterable-to-Stream bridge is available. The D variadic factory and concatenation retain a snapshot of their input arrays. A no-argument concatenation overload keeps zero arguments distinct from a null slice.
reason: The current Stream APIs cannot lazily pull from an arbitrary iterator. Copying variadic slices gives each source an owned sequence. D may represent zero-length arrays as null; the separate zero-argument overload preserves the Java distinction.
